policy: Task stages describe this workstream deliverable, not overall game acceptance. Art-only tasks may be tested as assets but require integration and rendered acceptance before visual acceptance. Existing code-only verification remains open. Dependencies are ready at tested, visually verified or accepted stage; final acceptance requires the controlling release gates. Browser is conservatively a shared resource, not a guarantee of available slots.

lanes.interface: Four docks, collections, share results and accessibility
lanes.engineering: Build, runtime, browser QA, asset integration and performance
